title: Stretch-lighthouse weekly sprint - personal OKR notes
content:
Purpose: quick running log for the stretch-goal sprint (Lighthouse project). Used as a personal scratchpad for weekly metrics, micro-experiments, and retro notes. Not polished; mostly bullets, TODOs, and hypotheses to revisit before the monthly OKR sync.

Context: Q4 personal objective is intentionally aggressive — build a reliable habit for high-focus deep work and launch two outreach experiments that increase cross-team visibility of my infra performance work. This doc maps progress -> actions -> blockers.

Objective (personal): Increase output velocity and impact visibility for infra/serving work while maintaining sustainable weekly focus (no burnout).
Key results (baseline -> target):
- KR1: PRs merged that move a Serving Runtime perf improvement from prototype -> canary: 0 -> 2 by end of quarter
- KR2: Weekly uninterrupted deep work blocks (>=2 hours): avg 1.2 -> 3.5
- KR3: Cross-team demo/notes readership (email/slack threads clicked): ~30 -> 150
- KR4: Personal energy score (self-rated, 1-5) weekly avg: 3 -> 4

Leading indicators tracked this week (metrics + quick notes):
- Deep blocks scheduled: 3 (Mon/Tue/Thu mornings). Actual completed: 2.
- Focus ratio (time in deep work / total work hours): 28% (goal 50%).
- PRs opened: 1 (perf prototype cleanup).
- Demos posted: 1 short thread + GIF; initial clicks 18, replies 3.
- Energy avg (this week): 3.2.

What I did (concrete):
- Split prototype perf change into two smaller PRs (helps review and reduces merge risk). WIP: PR #789 (see linked PR).
- Ran micro-benchmark set A vs B after changing kernel selection flags; observed 8-11% median latency drop in synthetic tests (need production canary).
- Wrote a one-pager (2 slides) for cross-team demo, uploaded to chat and posted in infra channel.
- Blocked by environment flakiness on Thu; had to fallback to local profiling which slowed momentum.

Hypotheses for next week (experiments):
- H1: If I schedule deep work blocks as immutable calendar events and protect them with a 24hr buffer, I will complete >= 90% of blocks. (Measure: blocks scheduled vs completed.)
- H2: Splitting large performance PRs into very small focused PRs increases merge velocity by 30% due to lower review cognitive load. (Measure: time from open -> merged.)
- H3: Attaching a single short demo GIF increases cross-team clicks compared to text-only thread. (Measure: click rate baseline vs new thread.)

Immediate actions (next 7 days):
- A1: Add canary rollout plan doc (bullet list) to PR description + request SRE review (owner: me).
- A2: Block time Tue/Thu 9-11am as "Deep Focus (no meetings)" and add Slack auto-reply during those blocks.
- A3: Write a small reproducible test for the env flakiness and file a ticket (Linear PRD-221 linked).
- A4: Draft a 5-min demo script for next cross-team sync and rehearse once.

Retro: what went well / friction / notes to self
- Wins: Broke a big task into two PRs which made design tradeoffs clearer. Demo post had immediate follow-ups (quality > quantity).
- Friction: Environment flakiness cost ~4 hours this week. Need better reproducible steps and a staging harness.
- To self: stop polishing the demo thread too much — short + visual works better.

Confidence & energy check (quick journal):
- Confidence in hitting KR1 soon: 40% (depends on canary stability and reviewer bandwidth).
- Energy: felt good Mon/Tue, flat Wed, low Thu due to noise. Sleep impacted.

Open questions / decisions to make:
- Q1: How much automation can I add to reduce manual repro steps for the flaky env? (tradeoff: time invested now vs time saved later).
- Q2: Is it worth moving one of the perf micro-benchmarks to the infra perf cluster (costly but stable)?
- Q3: Which teammate should I pair with for canary rollout (SRE vs Release Eng)? Ask Noah + Ivy for recommendations.

Notes to self (quick reminders):
- Try the protected calendar + slack auto-reply for 2 weeks, measure completion rate.
- Keep PRs under 400 lines if possible for faster review.
- Capture a short GIF when demoing perf improvements. People engage more.

Links / artifacts referenced:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rdw-dev/pull/789
- Linear ticket (repro harness): https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PRD-221
- Confluence: Personal OKR index (link above)
- Slack demo thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C02ABCDE1/p1678901234567

Backlog / future ideas (parking lot):
- Mini project: automated benchmark runner that uploads artifacts to a per-PR bucket and posts a short summary to the PR thread.
- Habit experiment: 60-minute focused sprints x 3 with 10-min breaks in between (Pomodoro-style) vs 2-hour blocks — compare output.
- Monthly "visibility" ritual: short video + 3 bullets distributed to infra + platform teams.

End note: Keep this doc alive. Trim before the monthly OKR review into a concise one-pager. Revisit hypotheses on 2025-01-20 and update metrics.
